activity.notes: Somare returned as Prime Minister after the 2002 election and remained the political holder of the office until Parliament elected Peter O'Neill on 2 August 2011 amid Somare's prolonged illness and the ensuing constitutional crisis. Temporary acting arrangements during illness are not split into separate ATLAS Activities because they did not represent a new elected Somare mandate.

sources.title: Michael Somare — office chronology
sources.citation_text: The office chronology records Somare's long third prime-ministerial period beginning in August 2002 and ending with the 2011 succession crisis.

sources.title: Papua New Guinea Department of Foreign Affairs — PNG History
sources.citation_text: The official historical summary identifies Somare as the central post-independence prime minister and notes Peter O'Neill's assumption of office in 2011.
